hash_id_encoding.order: first appearance in chronological output, including private tails

model_mapping.semantics: All selected source models use one target model; no model switching or original deployment reconstruction.

resource_estimates.semantics: Payload byte lower bounds only; excludes record headers, metadata, SQLite staging, JSONL and result files.

selection.arrival_semantics: Open-loop request replay; no agent dependency feedback or original provider service latency injected.
selection.cache_initial_state: cold at replay_start; preceding warmup requests simulated when requested
selection.cache_semantics: Chained o200k 16-token prefixes; request-private unknown tail; provider cache_read_tokens is provenance only.
selection.input_length_semantics: sum(role_tokens), o200k_base proxy; not exact target-model tokenization.
selection.output_length_semantics: Unmodified provider completion_tokens; target tokenizer conversion unavailable.
selection.timestamp_policy: Stable chronological order by start_ms, source week, original parquet row index; gaps and ties retained.
selection.zero_output_policy: Explicitly excluded; no fabricated output token; counts retained per time bin.

source.sha256_semantics: sha256 of canonical JSON ordered file identities (relative_path, sha256, size); not a file hash

user_turns.method: 通过周次和原表行号对齐回放请求。只计至少关联一条保留请求的用户输入，同一用户输入关联多次调用只计一轮。0 表示匹配到调用但原记录没有可归属的用户输入。

manifest.scope: Claude Code main transcripts with verified tool interleaving and explicit-root recovery
manifest.extraction_policy: requestId and tool ID linkage required to join interleaved fragments
manifest.timestamp_policy: first response event proxy, relative milliseconds
manifest.history_policy: logged messages only; system prompts and tool schemas omitted
manifest.output_policy: rendered completion plus EOS; lengths always recorded

user_turns.method: 以 session_id 和 response_id 匹配回放调用与主会话事件，把匹配的调用归入前一条 user_prompt。同一提示只计一次。仅覆盖至少匹配一条调用的回放会话，0 表示已有匹配调用但找不到更早的提示。
